segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some who are also acne-prone, mostly report the lotion doesn't feel greasier than their skin already is and causes no new breakouts, though one caution is that very oily skin in hot weather may find the dewy finish a bit more than needed.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who describes her own skin as dry initially found the formula wonderfully dewy and hydrating, but on a later use developed red spots with tight, dry skin and stinging that nothing would calm.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently report the lotion feels lightweight, doesn't clog pores or cause breakouts, and works well layered under makeup.
segments.sensitive: The reviewers who describe sensitive skin, including one who is also dry, report no irritation and a soothing, hydrating effect.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin, including one recovering from dryness caused by Tretinoin and winter weather, report the lotion is lightweight with no white cast and doesn't sting near the eyes.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as mature and easily tanned reports the lotion feels lightweight, not sticky or greasy.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer who raises fine lines directly says the formula seems to soften their appearance while hydrating her skin, though this is a single, tentative observation rather than a broadly repeated finding.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the lotion as hydrating, with several using it in place of a moisturizer; the one reviewer who had an adverse reaction reports her skin became tight and dry alongside redness and stinging.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation or redness, including several with sensitive skin; one reviewer, however, describes a reaction after repeated use with red spots, tight and dry skin, and stinging that nothing would calm.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone or oily/combination consistently report no new breakouts, including some who say sunscreen usually causes them acne or irritation but this one did not; no reviewer in this set reports a breakout from using it.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the lotion doesn't add oiliness or grease, including some with oily or oily/combination skin who report it feels no oilier than their skin already is; a couple note the finish gets shinier after several hours or that oil is harder to control when layered over a moisturizer, and one caution is that very oily skin in hot weather may find it a bit dewier than desired.

aspects.libelle: No white cast on any skin tone
Doesn't sting or burn the eyes
Layers well under makeup, no pilling
Feels thick going on before it absorbs

extraits.texte: I am familiar with the Vacation Inc. brand and have always had a good experience so I was excited to try their Classic Face Lotion SPF 45. I used it a few times & am a little stumped! The first time I used it, I liked it. It is thicker than a typical face lotion and has the typical beachy sunscreen smell. You don't have to use too much as it does apply pretty white, but as long as you rub it in, it dissolves. It felt dewy on my skin and for someone with dry skin- that was r her eat!However the last time I used it, my face skin went crazy! After a little bit of time passed, I had red spots all over and my skin felt very tight and dry. I'm not sure if this product caused it or not, but it was the last product I used so I'm assuming it was. Nothing would calm my skin down either & everything I tried after stung. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I recently had the opportunity to try the SPF 45 Face Lotion by Vacation for free in exchange for my honest review. I'm someone who wears sunscreen 365 days a year, so I know what I'm looking for in sun protection. Ill start with what I loved: it absorbs into my skin quickly and leaves a nice natural finish. It even seems to soften my fine lines and hydrate my skin, without feeling sticky or greasy. I was out all weekend and did not get any sunburnt/tan, so it's doing its job. Now here's what I'm not crazy about: it smells very much like a sunscreen you wear to the pool or beach. I personally prefer my sunscreens to be more discrete for daily use. After a few hours, my face looked a bit more shiny than after initial application. Overall, it's a solid sunscreen, but I may reserve this one for beach days. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I really liked this sunscreen! I have oily, acne-prone skin. I have a lighter skin tone and, while I do tan, I will begin to burn if I'm in direct sunlight for too long. I wear sunscreen on my face most days. This is definitely going to be added into my sunscreen rotation.The sunscreen itself is pretty thick. It was easy to apply over my skincare and didn't cause any issues with my makeup. It absorbed pretty quickly, too, and didn't leave a white cast (granted, this could be different with darker skin tones). It doesn't feel heavy or greasy on the skin and I didn't feel any more oily than I already do throughout the day. It has a pretty strong coconut and banana scent, which reminded me of some of the sunscreens I used as a kid in the 2000s. The scent isn't overbearing and doesn't really linger. I'm a bit sensitive to scents due to migraines, but I didn't have any issues with it.The tube comes with a flip up/snap top and it's easy to control how much sunscreen comes out. I didn't have any issues with the cap seeming flimsy or excess product coming out.I did find this a bit annoying to reapply during the day, but that's true for most sunscreens. After spending time out in the sun (partially covered) while trialling, I did not notice any sunburns.I'm pretty happy with this and, again, will definitely be adding it to my rotation of sunscreens. I received this product in exchange for my honest review. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Easily absorbs in skin, light weight & breathable
extraits.texte: Received this SPF 45 sunscreen face lotion from Vacation as a part of educational promotion.Used it couple of times while stepping out for my hike, must say the texture is super lightweight and breathable, and it melts into the skin almost instantly. I didn't feel any heaviness, or greasiness, and most importantly no typical white sunscreen cast. Instead, it leaves my skin with a really nice natural, sun kissed glow, which I personally love for everyday wear.It has a coconut and banana scent, which is such a cool touch.Skin loving ingredients in the formula caught my eye, like Aloe Vera, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid, and Vitamin E, which actually helped my sensitive and dry skin keeping it hydrated and moisturized and it also felt soothing to my skin.Plus it's SPF 45 with water resistance up to 80 minutes, which is amazing for daily sun protection.And how can I not talk about the packaging, the colors of the bottle literally look like summer on the beach bright and playful, with a tropical motif.Must have sunscreen face lotion, highly recommend.I am definitely going to buy it again, love this one as it's solves my purpose clearly. Adding glow, definitely breathable, sun protected look for everyday wear, and yes I wore it under makeup as well so it's a big find for my dry and very sensitive skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Vacation SPF 45 Face Lotion has made my 'Fun in the Sun' time stress free! I am a firm believer that a good SPF is the secret to good healthy and younger looking skin. I take extra care in choosing the right sunscreen for my light and mature skin which tans easily if exposed to the sun for longer hours. This is the first time I tried Vacation's SPF lotion and I am very impressed with the results so far. It is lightweight, absorbs without leaving any residue and fragrance free. It doesnt feel sticky or greasy unlike many other sunscreen brands I have tried before and is compatible with layering makeup over it. A must have in my sun care regimen. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Face SPF 45 lotion by Vacation is going to be a sunscreen I use on a daily basis. I have oily/ combination skin and acne-prone skin ,and this sunscreen has not caused any breakouts on my skin. Also there is no white cast left behind when rubbed into my skin. Which is great for my brown skin tone. The Face SPF 45 sunscreen leaves my skin with a nice glow without feeling and looking greasy. Also the smell of the sunscreen has a nice coconut scent. Not an overpowering smell either. This sunscreen sits really well under my makeup and I even used the Face SPF 45 lotion as a primer. My makeup looked good all day and lasted all day. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.
